thread:
Marta: quick heads-up — noticed a weird discrepancy: BLEU down ~3pts for quantized llama-v2-7b in the new bring-up, but ROUGE-L and BERTScore look fine. running eval-runner on the same shards.
Trevor: do you have the per-shard numbers? my gut: aggregation bug (mean vs weighted mean).
Marta: grabbing logs now, but summary: 8 shards, BLEU per-shard = [12.3, 11.8, 3.2, 12.0, 11.9, 12.1, 12.0, 11.7], shard sizes = [50,50,6,50,50,50,50,50] — global BLEU computed by scorer on full set is ~11.9 but runner report shows 10.9.
Alyssa: yep that's classic. runner does naive mean(scores) across shards which underweights big shards when one tiny shard is low. need weighted by sample count.
Trevor: reproduction snippet: 
```python
def aggregate(shard_scores, shard_counts):
    # WRONG (what runner currently does)
    return sum(shard_scores) / len(shard_scores)

# CORRECT
def weighted_agg(shard_scores, shard_counts):
    return sum(s*c for s,c in zip(shard_scores, shard_counts)) / sum(shard_counts)
```
Alyssa: also check BLEU brevity penalty — that tiny shard had a lot of short preds, so it drags BLEU down; ROUGE less sensitive.
Jamie: is this only for BLEU? what about ROUGE-L and BERTScore aggregation in runner? we might be exposing same bug across metrics.
Marta: good Q. looked at code: metrics/common/aggregator.py has `mean()` call in `shard_aggregate` for all metrics, so yep it's blanket. BERTScore used the exact scorer on combined outputs for our local check so it matched.
Trevor: plan: patch aggregator to weighted, add unit test that simulates uneven shard sizes + a tiny low-quality shard, ensure aggregated == gold (compute over concatenated examples). add integration test in CI to run small synthetic job.
Alyssa: PR prep: I'll add test + fix, tag @eng-ml-reviewers, link to internal eval id `eval-run-2026-03-19-llama2-q` and PR #4523.
ci-bot: re-run requested: eval-run-2026-03-19-llama2-q queued (job 8932).
Jamie: also add a doc note in runner README about "aggregation semantics" and call out that per-shard micro-benchmarks can mislead.
Marta: yep, and can we add small smoke check to alert if any shard has < 0.1 * median_shard_size? that would flag odd tiny shards.
Trevor: good idea. I'll add a warning log + opt-in fail-for-small-shards flag.
Alyssa: timeline: fix + unit tests today, CI integration test tomorrow, aim for release v0.9.3 patch.
Marta: thanks — this explains the regression on quant bring-up. feel better now. :thumbsup:
Jamie: awesome, thanks all.
